article.story: SAN DIEGO -- — Aniwaniwa Tait-Jones had 19 points and UC San Diego upped its win streak to nine with an 83-44 romp over Hawaii on Saturday night. Tait-Jones also grabbed five rebounds for the Tritons (24-4, 14-2 Big West Conference). Tyler McGhie had 17 points and Nordin Kapic hit three 3-pointers and scored 13. The Rainbow Warriors (14-13, 6-10) were led by Ryan Rapp with nine points. Harry Rouhliadeff added eight points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
